device.category: 2-note paraphonic analogue synthesizer, 37 keys, with arpeggiator, 64-step sequencer and 256 presets
device.based_on: Development of the Moog Sub Phatty (2013), adding duo mode, a second mod bus, looping DAHDSR envelopes and the sequencer; released 2014.

sources.title: Moog Sub 37 Owner's Manual (2015)
sources.note: Connections, every panel section, step sequencer and step edit, MIDI, preset edit, global and controllers menus, CC chart, NRPN chart (partly read), specifications.

architecture.polyphony_mode: monophonic or duophonic (duo mode: each oscillator plays its own note through one filter)
architecture.patch_memory_note: 256 presets (16 banks x 16), each with its own 64-step sequence; a PANEL mode plays the knobs live.
architecture.summary: Two oscillators with continuously variable waveshape (triangle to narrow pulse), hard sync and duo mode; a square sub oscillator an octave below Osc 1; pink noise; and a feedback channel (mixer output back into the mixer) that becomes an external input when EXT IN is used. Levels above 5 overdrive the 20 Hz-20 kHz Moog ladder filter (6, 12, 18 or 24 dB/oct), followed by MultiDrive, the VCA and output. Two mod buses each pair an LFO (or the filter EG, or a programmable source) with pitch, filter and switched destinations, scaled by mod wheel, velocity, aftertouch and a fourth controller. Two looping DAHDSR envelopes, glide, arpeggiator, 64-step sequencer.

modules.name: Keyboard and note control
modules.description: 37 semi-weighted keys with velocity and aftertouch, KB octave ±2, transpose ±12, note priority; in duo mode Osc 1 and Osc 2 take separate notes per KB CTRL.

modules.name: Pitch and Mod wheels
modules.description: Pitch bend (range and destination per preset) and mod wheel (default depth of MOD 1).

modules.name: Arpeggiator and sequencer
modules.description: Arpeggiator (up, down, order, random; range ±2 octaves; back/forth, invert) at 2-280 BPM, synced divisions or tap tempo; 1-64 step paraphonic sequencer with rests, ties, ratchets, skips and per-step mod values.

modules.name: LFO 1
modules.description: LFO for mod bus 1: triangle, square, saw, ramp or sample and hold; 0.1-100 Hz, x10 with HI RANGE; sync, KB reset, keyboard tracking, swing.

modules.name: Mod bus 1
modules.description: Picks the LFO wave or F.EG/PGM source and sends it to oscillator pitch (PITCH AMT, chosen oscillators), filter cutoff (FILTER AMT) and one switched destination (MOD AMT). Overall depth from mod wheel, velocity, aftertouch and CTRL4 amounts (mod wheel by default).

modules.name: LFO 2
modules.description: LFO for mod bus 2: triangle, square, saw, ramp or sample and hold; 0.1-100 Hz, x10 with HI RANGE; sync, KB reset, keyboard tracking, swing.

modules.name: Mod bus 2
modules.description: Picks the LFO wave or F.EG/PGM source and sends it to oscillator pitch (PITCH AMT, chosen oscillators), filter cutoff (FILTER AMT) and one switched destination (MOD AMT). Overall depth from mod wheel, velocity, aftertouch and CTRL4 amounts.

modules.name: Oscillator 1
modules.description: Waveshape continuously variable from triangle through saw and square to narrow pulse; 16'-2'.

modules.name: Oscillator 2
modules.description: As Osc 1, plus FREQUENCY (±7 semitones, ±3 octaves when droning), BEAT (±3.5 Hz) and hard sync to Osc 1.

modules.name: Sub oscillator
modules.description: Square wave exactly one octave below Osc 1.

modules.name: Feedback / external input
modules.description: Feeds the mixer output back into its fifth channel; a plug in EXT IN replaces the feedback with the external signal.

modules.name: Mixer
modules.description: Five channels with level and mute: Osc 1, Sub, Osc 2, Noise, FDBK/EXT. Above 5 a channel overdrives the filter input.

modules.name: Ladder filter
modules.description: Moog low-pass ladder, 20 Hz-20 kHz, slope 6, 12, 18 or 24 dB/oct; self-oscillates above resonance 7; EG amount and keyboard tracking (1:1 at half, 2:1 at full).

modules.name: MultiDrive
modules.description: OTA and FET drive stages between filter and VCA, from tube-like warmth to hard clipping.

modules.name: Filter envelope
modules.description: DAHDSR (delay and hold via KNOB SHIFT), 1 ms-10 s stages, velocity and key tracking amounts, multi-trigger, reset, clock sync, loop, latch; gate source and exponential attack in PRESET EDIT.

modules.name: Amplifier envelope
modules.description: DAHDSR (delay and hold via KNOB SHIFT), 1 ms-10 s stages, velocity and key tracking amounts, multi-trigger, reset, clock sync, loop, latch; gate source and exponential attack in PRESET EDIT.

modules.name: VCA
modules.description: Driven by the amplifier envelope; modulatable (VCA LEVEL destination) and by the VOL CV input.

modules.name: Output
modules.description: MASTER VOLUME to AUDIO OUT (with MUTE) and the headphone output (own volume, unaffected by MUTE); mono.

behaviours.name: Signal path
behaviours.rule: Five mixer channels into the ladder filter (levels above 5 overdrive its input, per source), then MultiDrive, the VCA and the output. The fifth channel is mixer feedback until EXT IN is used.

behaviours.name: Duo mode
behaviours.rule: With DUO MODE on, KB CTRL HI gives Osc 2 the highest note and Osc 1 the lowest; LO the reverse; OFF makes Osc 2 drone with FREQUENCY widened to ±3 octaves. Both share the filter and VCA.

behaviours.name: Mod buses
behaviours.rule: Each bus takes one source (five LFO waves, or F.EG/PGM) to pitch, filter and one switched destination at once, with separate bipolar amounts. Overall depth comes from mod wheel, velocity, aftertouch and CTRL4 amounts; MOD 1 follows the mod wheel by default. MOD 1's LFO RATE destination is LFO 2 and vice versa. Hold MOD DEST and touch a control to make it the PGM destination.

behaviours.name: Envelopes
behaviours.rule: DAHDSR with KNOB SHIFT for delay, hold, velocity and key tracking. Single trigger by default (no retrigger on legato); MULTI TRIG, RESET, SYNC to a clock division, LOOP (a multi-stage LFO) and LATCH ON. Amp delay only works with LOOP on.

behaviours.name: Glide
behaviours.rule: LCR (time grows with interval), LCT (fixed time) or EXP; GATED glides only while keys are held; LEGATO only between overlapping notes; per-oscillator assignment.

behaviours.name: Arpeggiator
behaviours.rule: UP, DWN, ORDR or RND over -2 to +2 octaves; BACK/FORTH makes patterns bidirectional (END NOTES once or twice); INVERT plays each note in successive octaves; LATCH keeps it going; SYNC follows MIDI clock (no playback without clock unless tap tempo); swing and gate length in PRESET EDIT.

behaviours.name: Step sequencer
behaviours.rule: PATTERN to REC with the arp off: keys enter steps (up to 64), ON adds rests, LATCH ties; duo mode records two notes per step. PATTERN to SEQ and ON to play, transposed by the key pressed. Step edit (BANK + LATCH): per-step notes, rests, ties, skips, ratchets (1-8x shared count), first/last step, rotate, page through 4 x 16 steps. The mod wheel position is stored per step for SEQ MOD.

behaviours.name: Preset and panel modes
behaviours.rule: PRESET plays stored values until a knob moves (pickup per POT MODE); PANEL plays the knobs live with non-knob settings in a buffer. COMPARE auditions the stored preset. Each preset stores its own sequence.

behaviours.name: CV inputs
behaviours.rule: PITCH CV (1 V/oct), FILTER CV and VOL CV take 0-5 V or expression pedals; KB GATE takes a +5 V gate. PITCH, VOL and GATE can be remapped in GLOBAL to other parameters, step advance, step 1 reset or sustain.

behaviours.name: Warm-up and calibration
behaviours.rule: Up to 60 s to stabilise from cold. Note calibration (MIDI notes 15-116), aftertouch and CV input calibration are in GLOBAL 3.1.

receives.note: panel controls, 7- or 14-bit (paired MSB/LSB CCs 1-31 + 33-63); see parameter access entries
every panel parameter (MSB 3/4), for full control
followed when FOLLOW SPP is on

midi.channel_note: Separate in (1-16 or omni) and out channels; ports selectable DIN, USB or both; DIN and USB input can be echoed to the outputs.
midi.note: Every knob and switch sends and receives MIDI. Moog's free editor/librarian is available on registration.

specifications.sound_sources: 2 variable-waveshape oscillators, square sub, pink noise, external input / feedback
specifications.filter: 20 Hz-20 kHz Moog ladder, 6/12/18/24 dB/oct, MultiDrive

connections.audio: 1 x TS out, 1 x TRS headphones, 1 x TS external input

omitted_from_source: the full NRPN chart (only the arpeggiator, glide, oscillator, mixer, filter and filter EG entries were read)
not_in_source: CC numbers for many switches (NRPN only)
source_inconsistencies: The LFO range is 0.1-100 Hz (x10 with HI RANGE) in the panel text, 0.01-1000 Hz in the specifications, and Low/Med/Hi ranges in the CC chart.
The filter envelope's VEL AMT is said to use the DECAY knob, but the overview (and the amp envelope text) give it to the SUSTAIN knob.
The CC chart calls the envelope sustain controls 'SUSTAIN TIME'; sustain is a level.
The Programming section says the menus are on 'page 35 (MIDI) and page 43 (GLOBAL)'; the PRESET EDIT reference points to page 39 while its contents start on page 39-40.
The specifications list 'Osc 2' as a mod destination without 'pitch'.
Amp hold is described as between 'attack and sustain stages', filter hold as between attack and decay.

modelling_gaps.detail: About 80 PGM destinations are grouped into a short list; SEQ MOD DST and CV mapping accept almost any parameter.
Up to 64 steps per preset (notes, velocity, rests, ties, skips, ratchets, mod values) are described, not modelled as parameters.
Up to 16 units via POLY NUMBER/POLY MAX with compatible Moog synths; modelled as a global setting.
